tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla chen 'phags pa'i dngul gdung rin po che'i dkar chag dge legs bcud kyi nying khu myong grol chen mo bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bstan pa'i gtso bo thub dbang lha yi lha/ /de sras gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gang gi rnam sprul rje btsun sa skya pa/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la phyag bgyi 'o/ /sngon tshe sprul pa'i lo tsā dpal brtsegs bsrung / /phyi rabs rgyal sras sa ston rir grags pa/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs skyong phyir slar byon pa'i/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i mtshan khyod bsngags par 'os/ /'khrungs ma thag nas ngo mtshar rnam thar gyi/ /skyes mchog 'phags pa zhes su kun la grags/ /rtsod bral mkhas grub du ma'i chos kyi mdzod/ /ma lus kun gyi bdag po ma lags sam/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad pa'i phyir/ /kun gyi mchod 'os sa skya'i gdung rigs su/ /bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ /'phags pa'i mtshan gang don la gnas gyur pa/ /'gro ba 'dren mdzad khyed la 'gran nus pa/ /'ga' zhig yod na la la ston par rigs/ /kha cig chos kyi 'byor pas phyug gyur kyang / /srid pa'i 'byor pas rang srog 'tsho ba tsam/ /sa skyong rgyal po srid la dbang 'byor yang / /chos kyi dbang phyug nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /srid pa'i 'byor pa 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal dang / /chos kyi 'byor pa zas gtsang sras lta bu/ /gang zag gcig la ngo mtshar rmad byung chos/ /ma lus rdzogs par mnga' ba khyod lta bu/ /sngon chad ma byung phyis kyang mi 'byung bar/ /mngon sum grub phyir snying nas dad pas 'dud/ /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul rgyun mi chad pa'i gnas/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /'bum thang gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'chad la spro/ /de la 'dir mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na g.yo ba'i gdung rabs rin po che'i phreng ba 'di nyid la mkhas grub kyi skyes bu bzang po rim par byon pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rje btsun gong ma lnga zhes rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu de dag gi nang tshan bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi phyi rten gser 'bum chen mor nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bur bgyis pa'i dkar chag mdo tsam 'bri na/

de yang skyes chen dam pa 'di ni bstan pa snga dar gyi lo tsā ba chen po ka ba dpal brtsegs kyi sku skyer slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lung bstan gsal po yod cing / spyan ras gzigs dang gsung gleng rtag tu mdzad pa'i sa ston ri par grags pa cig gi sku skye de ma thag par zhal gyis bzhes/ de'i grwa pa rnams ngo mkhyen pa sogs chung ngu nas byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das/ bslab pa'i gnas dang sgyu rtsal tshegs chung ngus mkhyen/ bla ma 'di dang 'gro mgon phyag na ste sku mched gnyis kas sgo rum du nyi zer la na bza' dang 'khor gsum bkal/ kun gyis 'di ni 'phags pa'o zhes bsgrags pas 'phags par grags/ dgung lo gsum pa la sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ brgyad pa la skyes rabs/ dgu pa la brtag gnyis thugs las gsungs/ tshogs pa thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar/ de ltar na skyes stobs kyi thugs rab ni chos rje las kyang lhag par mkhas pa rnams la grags so/ /bcu pa la chos rje'i phyag phyir gong du byon pa'i mar lam zul phur/ chos rje pas mkhan po/ zul phu ba na bza' 'phrod gsol du grags pa chos dbang bas slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung / skyor mo lung pa shes rab seng ge la kā ri kā gsan te lhag par tshul khrims kyi bslab pas phyug par mdzad do/ /de ltar dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i bar chos rje las dbang khrid bshad pa phal cher rdzogs/ shin tu mnyes nas chos dung / lhung bzed/ phyag dpe/ tshogs pa rnams gtad/ bstan pa'i khur bskur/ bcu bdun pa chos rje dang / bco brgyad pa la byang phyogs rgyal po go dan yang gshegs/ de nas se chen gyis gdan drangs/ brtag pa dang dri ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas yid ches shing / btsun mos/ mtshams sbyar nas mos gus khyad par can tshud/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa chu mo glang gi lo gsar la se chen gan gyis dbang bskur zhus/ g.yang kri'u las byas pa'i yi ge dang rin po che'i ri mo yod pa'i dam ga phul/

ti shrī'i mtshan gsol/ gser dang mu tig gi snam sbyar/ sku chos/ phyam tshe/ dbu zhwa/ chags l+h+wam/ bzhugs gdan/ gser gyi khri/ gdugs/ gsol zhal/ gsol sder la sogs tshang ma/ rnga mong dang chibs dril gser gyi sga skor tshang ma gtso bor dbus gtsang gi khri skor bcu gsum/ sgos su gtsang chu mig gi khri skor du gang gtogs phyag phyir phul/ phyi lo stag lo de la ban+dhe shed bskyed bod yig tu bris pa dang / dngul bri chen lnga bcu rtsa drug ja sig nyis brgya/ gos yug brgyad cu dang / dar yug stong dang brgya phul lo/ /stag lo 'di la rgya gar du ru kas bzung yod mtshams hor dmag khyer/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshem mche ba gdan 'dren par byed/ de bar 'phags pa rin po che byang ngos su byon/ chos rje'i sku 'bum bzhengs/ 'u yug pa gdan 'dren btang nas mdo khams su bsnyen rdzogs mdzad rtsis la 'u yug pa grong snye thang pa grags pa seṅges mkhan po mdzad/ las slob jo gdan byang thang pa bsod rgyal/ gsang ston yar lung pa byang rgyal/ dad dge mkhan po sgro dang gnam 'phar ba sogs chos rje'i bu chen mang po bsags nas dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing mo yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ rgya bod kyi mtshams he ci'u dang nye ba'i sar rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes so/ /dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i sbrul gyi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gsum pa'i nub mo/ /chos rje mngon sum du byon nas zab rgyas kyi chos gsung lung bstan dbugs dbyung bas bstod pa yang mdzad/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma yang de dus mdzad par byed do/ /de nas hor yi ge med pa la yig gsar brtsams/ de'i phud la ban+dhe shed bskyed thags ma phul/ dbang yon bar ma la bod chol kha gsum/ tha ma la rgya'i mi yur chen mo phul/ bod thams cad sa skya pa'i chos lugs las gzhan pa byed dbang med pa'i lung 'bud gsung ba la/

rang rang gi chos lugs gang yod bskyang du 'jug pa cis kyang dgos gsung nas/ yon mchod gnyis ka'i 'ja' sa thams cad la rang rang gi chos lugs la 'bad pa thon gsungs pa sha stag yod pas dbang spus shin tu bzang ba yin no/ /rgya nag gi chos lugs log par spyod pa'i zin shing ston pa bcu bdun bstan pa la shin du sdang bar yod pa rnams ni rig pa rnam dag gis btul nas bstan pa la btsud/ rgya/ hor/ ljang / yu gur/ mi nyag la sogs pa'i skal ldan snod du rung ba rnams la/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs lo re'i nang du stong phrag re tsam rang gis gnang ba dang / mkhan po 'dul 'dzin chos mgon zhes bya ba sman rtse'i yul du brdzangs nas/ des kyang rab byung dgu brgya tsam dang / rje nyid kyis gnang ba snga rting dril ba la bzhi stong bzhi brgya nyer lnga mdzad de/ rgya nag gi rgyal khams rab byung gis gang bar mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo nyer brgyad pa chu pho khyi la cha rkyen mang du bskur bar mdzad pa rnams la brten nas/ dpon chen shākya bzang pos dbu rtse sgo gsum gser thog chen mo dang bcas pa/ gser 'bum chen mo g.yu thog dang bcas pa dang / thub pa chen po'i gser sku la sogs pa bzhengs/ de'i phyi lo chu mig chos 'khor sngon ma la dge 'dun brgyad khri tsam la 'bul 'gyed gya nom pa gnang / hor yul nas yar byon pa'i lam khar mdo khams tsam mdo gnas gsar du nye gnas chen po rin chen ston tshul gyis do dam byas nas gser gyi glegs bam phyed dang nyis stong la sogs pa rten gsum sde dgon/ mi nor gyi 'bul ba grangs med pa bzhes nas dgung lo so gcig shing mo glang la sa skyar phebs/ gser thog chen mo'i gzhug tshags/ gser 'bum bkra shis sgo mang / rje gong ma'i phyag rten skya 'bum bdun la gser gyi gdugs chos 'khor/ sgos su chos rje'i phyi rten la gser thog bka' 'gyur la sogs pa gser gyi pu ti nyis brgya lhag pa la sogs pa bzhengs/

de lta bu'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten gyi gtso bor gyur nas kyang / mdo sngags dbang bshad kyi rgyud zab mo nyams kyi dogs nas/ de dus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang ba dang / lung rgya che ba chung 'bring mtha' dag bla mar bsten/ rang bzhed pa'i chos de 'dug na mo btsun phal pa gcig la 'dug kyang / nga rgyal dang / khengs pa dang / gzhan gyis smod pa sogs gang la yang mi dgongs par gus pas gtsug tu bzhes nas chos zhus te/ de dag gi rnam thar rgyas pa gsan yig sogs nas gsal lo/ /chos kyi ched yin kyang 'di lta bu'i che 'gyings bcag pa ni gzhan sus kyang sgrub par dka'o/ /de nas dgung lo so gsum pa me mo yos la 'gro mgon phyag na sku gshegs pa'i chos 'khor chu mig tu mdzad pa la dge 'dun dgu khri la 'bul 'gyed bgrang ba las 'das so/ /de rjes de ma thag hor gyis gdan 'dren par nan ches nas lo gzhug de la 'dam du phebs par byon/ phyis lo sa pho 'brug la paṇa chen shākya bzang pos lha khang chen mo bzhengs/ khri skor bcu gsum bskul/ dpon chen kun dga' bzang po dang sbrel nas rdzogs par grub/ rin chen sgang / lha khang bla brang / dus mchod bla brang rnams kyang bzhengs so/ /gong du phebs nas dgung lo so drug pa lcags pho rta la dbang zhus pa'i tshe/ mi nyag rgya rgod kyi rgyal po'i shel dam la bcos byas nas shel dam gling drug ma dang / mu tig gi 'ja' sa phul/ gnam gyi 'og sa'i steng na rgya gar lha'i sras po/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas/ yi ge rtsom mi/ rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug pa po/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'phags pa ti shrī zhes mtshan gsol/ dngul bre chen stong ra chen dang / gos dar lnga khri dgu stong la sogs pa phul/ mjal res kyi mthong phyag dang mjal dngul bre chag med sogs mdzad pas/ rgyal po'i 'phral gyi 'bul ba kun dril bas gser bre brgyad lhag dngul bre stong ra chen/

gos dar bzhi khri la sogs pa byung bar bshad do/ /de nas zho gnyis pa me pho khyi lo la sa skyar phebs/ bod kyi dge bshes skya btsun thams cad la/ bod kyi dbang bshad lung man ngag thams cad nga la yod pas nyan du shog ces bka' gnang nas/ zhe drug pa'i bar la chos dang zang zing gi char phab/ khyad par glang lo la chu mig chos 'khor chen mo la zhag bco lnga'i bar du dge 'dun 'bum phrag gcig la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa mdzad tshul bsam gyis mi khyab/ de ltar bskyangs pa'i slob ma'i mchog kyang shar nub gung gsum/ khang gnyan zhang gsum/ la ru ba/ nyan chen pa/ spru lung pa/ lo mchog dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ gsal la ba 'od zer 'bum/ dbus pa seng 'bum/ dam pa kun dga' grags la sogs pa brgyud pa 'dzin nges kyang mang du byon/ gzhan gyi snang ngor bstan pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan yi dam gyi lha'i zhal gzigs pa dang / 'od gsal rgyun mi chad pa dang / mngon par shes pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ste skyid grong du jo bo'i drung du byon pa'i tshe/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gzigs pa la mnal lam du bstod pa mdzad pa dang / ri bo rtse lngar byon pa'i tshe/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad pa dang / yang chos rje sa paṇa byang ngos la 'byon pa'i dus su/ yang dgon pas mjal te/ bla ma ni gong la gshegs par gda'/ bdag cag slob ma rnams la phyag dang bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / mos gus kyi gnas su gyur pa'i sku tshab cig 'tshal bar gda' ba la/ dbon po 'di pa yang dag pa lags sam zhus pas/ dbon po rnal ma lags gsungs nas/ bla ma 'di pha tshad na rdo gcig 'dug pa la brnyes/ spyan ma btsum par mnal du song 'dug pa bstan nas/ 'di 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags lags/ spyir nged kyi mi rgyud rnal ma la 'od gsal cung zad re rgyun mi chad du yod pa yin gsung /

rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta go ti shrī bha dra la mtshan mo rmi lam ji ltar byung ba thams cad/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mngon par shes pas mkhyen nas/ nang par paṇ+ḍi ta la gsung byon pa'i tshe/ ma hā gu ru la mngon par shes pa a tse zer zhing dad par gyur to/ /bla ma 'di gong nas phebs/ 'u yug na bzhugs dus phyogs su khral sdud byung ba la/ shong lha phu ba'i jo gdan cig gis zhu ba la phyin dus/ sgar gyi mthar sems can la 'tshe ba byed pa/ hor sog mang pos mtha' bskor/ bla ma 'di pa 'ja' li gcig la bzhugs/ g.yas na rtsom pa mdzad pa'i yig mkhan/ g.yon na bka' shog 'bri ba'i yig mkhan/ mdun du rgyun gtor shom pa'i gtor skad bton nas chab gtong ba rnams mthong bas/ jo gdan gyi bsam pa la bla ma ci'i bla ma sems can la 'tshe ba/ mtha' hor sog gis bskor ba/ g.yon gyi bka' shog ni nga zhu ba la 'ong pa dang 'dra/ gzhan dpyad pa yin/ g.yas kyi rtsom pas ci byed/ chos sems thog tu mi 'jog tshig gcig kyang mi bsngo ba'i gtor skad kyis ci byed/ bla mar mi 'dug snyam pa cig byung ba dang / bdag nyid chen po 'dis jo gdan la spyan cer te gzigs nas/ gtor ma 'di la bshams pas thob pa khos bshams pa yin/ dmigs pas thob pa de ngas byed/ bsngos pas thob pa de khyed kyis gyis gsungs pa dang / jo gdan shin tu skrag nas/ mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pa mnga' bar 'dug pa la/ ngas log lta byas pa ma legs snyam nas lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag byas/ bshags pa phul/ mchog tu ngo mtshar bar gyur te bstod tshig gi sgra dbyangs kun tu sgrog par gyur/ bla ma'i mdzad spyod thams cad gang la gang 'dul du rtogs/ sems can gsod gcod/ khral 'u la sogs rang gi las su go nas nges pa'i shes pa khyad par can skyes par gyur to/ /de ltar dgung lo bco brgyad pa nas zhe drug pa'i bar nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar la gdan sa che 'bring chung gsum/

rgya bod kyi chos sde phal mo che'i bdag rkyen bkod bzhag skyong dar la sogs pas nyin mtshan 'das par mdzad nas zhe drug pa lcags pho 'brug gi smal po zla ba'i nyi shu gnyis la dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa rgyas par shoms gsungs nas rdo rje skyil krung mdzad/ rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba'i ngang nas rma bya chen mo dang / dpal mgon klu sgrub la sogs pa mngon sum du gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma dang bcas te/ lha khang chen mo'i bla brang du bde bar gshegs so/ /de skabs su bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu du ma dang sbyin bdag gi gtso bo stong khun gong ma chen po yum sras blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dang khri skor bcu gsum la do dam zhal lta mdzad pa'i sa skya dpon chen rnams kyis dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho lta bur bsgrubs shing / khyad par nyid kyi sku'i dbon po dharma pha la rak+ṣi tas nang rten lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod na bzhugs pa'i thub dbang lha chen dpal 'bar/ phyi rten gser 'bum chen mo lha khang ldebs bris dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs mdzad pa la shar chen 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gnyis kyi sku dus la gser thog gi gzhi bting / la stod na zlum pa dpon chen kun gzhon gyis gser phib bkal dus dbu rtse'i gser phib las cung zad chung bar byung bas gser phib chung ba zhes grags/ de ltar skyes chen dam pa de dag gi rten bzhengs mchod rgyun bzang po dang bcas par bsgrubs par mdzad mod/ bar skabs su si tu byang rgyal la sogs pa bstan dgra gdug pa can byas shes drin gzo'i blo med pa du ma zhig gis gdan sa chen po la zhabs 'dren blos mi 'khyud pa zhus dus nas bzung rim pas 'jig nye la thug skabs sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis rje btsun gong ma'i phyi rten yongs rdzogs la nyams gso mdzad dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung tshul gong gi rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho na gsal ba ltar dang /

yang de nas ring po ma lon par 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis nyams gso mdzad tshul ni/ 'dren pa gong gi rtogs brjod mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i gsung rtsom ma las/ de nas rje nyid dgung lo zhe drug pa nyi ma zhes pa chu mo lug lo'i skabs shig nyer gcig gi bla mchod 'bum thang du mdzad pa'i tshe/ sa chen dang / slob dpon rtse mo'i phyi rten sku 'bum gnyis las dbang gi chu rgyun dwangs la mang ba nyi ma gnyis kyi bar du bab pas/ rje nyid mchod rten 'di dag byin rlabs che bar sngar las kyang thugs yid ches shing thugs dad che bar gyur/ de mthun sprel lo nas lo yang shin tu legs shing / mi rnams bde bas 'tsho ba 'di byung snang zhing / de nas ma 'gyangs par 'bum thang la zhig gsos zhig kyang gnang bas/ rje btsun chen po'i phyi rten las khrus chu 'byung ba snga sor nas chad cing / sa chen dang / slob dpon rin po che'i phyi rten gnyis la yang cho 'phrul sogs dus chen rnams la cung zad re ma gtogs/ rgyun du 'byung ba zhig de snga med kyang / de dus zhig gsos grub 'phral nas zla ba du ma'i bar du nyin re bzhin khrus chu ting re tsam re mchod rten gsum char nas 'bab cing / de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar nyi ma gcig gnyis ma gtogs phal cher rgyun mi chad par 'byon pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su snang zhing / de bzhin du 'phags pa rin po che'i phyi rten gtor 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang gi lho skya yongs rdzogs dang / steng gi gser tog gi shing rnams gsar du rtsa ba nas spod pa mdzad cing / zangs len gser byugs ma rnams phal cher mdog 'don dang / gling gnyis tsam gsar pa spo ba sogs kyi nyams gso dang bstun/ nang gi logs bris la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mang po'i sku dang / 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku brgya phrag lnga lhag tsam sogs bri bar mdzad cing /

gzhan yang dar 'phan ting bdun cha/ rol mo la sogs mchod cha mang po dang bcas pa'i nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu mdzad pa'i skabs der/ rje nyid nyin gcig la grwa'i gseb tu zhal bkod zhig la phebs pa'i tshe/ gtor 'bul la byin rlabs zhu bar mdzad pa na/ de ma thag mchod rten gyi bum bzang las byung ba 'dra ba'i dri bzang khyad par can zhig thul gyis byung nas 'bum thang gi steng 'og thams cad khyab nas kun kyang ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa zhig byung 'dug pa 'di ni dpal ldan 'phags pa dges pa'i mtshan ma'am/ yang na dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha dag gnas der mchod pa la lhag pa'i rtags mtshan du gor ma chag cing / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de rjes su sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can gyis zhabs tog mdzad tshul ni/ rje de nyid kyi rnam thar chen 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho las/ yang rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta lo nas bzung gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i ngo mtshar ba'i rten rnam bzhi sprul pa'i lha khang chen mos mtshon te gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la nyams chag phran bu byung ba rnams gso bar mdzad pa ni gtso bor yab rje dam pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / lhag par sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi mar sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i thog gdan sa chen po'i bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad skabs dka' spyad sdug 'khur mdzad pa rnams sngon gnas dran pa lta bu'i mod la rang re rnams sngon sa skya zer ba'i gyang gog dmar tsam/ nang gi rten gsum rnams bya mang 'du ba'i shing gog lta bur skya hrul ba/ dam pa'i chos rnams mun gling dug lo ltar rlung gi yar log mar log byed dus bstan tshugs kyi re ba byed dgos byung na/ da ltar ji ltar hrul kyang zla ba gsum khongs su 'dems pa zhig nges par yong bas thog mar chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gser 'bum mthong grol chen mo'i ngos kyi gos chen 'thul ba dang /

gser chab gsar sgron de nyid kyi 'dra sku rme ba can la dpe byas pa'i sku brnyan che ba gsar bzhengs/ gser 'bum gyi chos 'khor yan la gser zangs bskyar 'bul gser phib shing bsgrigs nas bzung bskyar 'gel thog gnam rgyan sa rgyan sogs lag 'byor rnams rim gyis mchod khang zhabs tog du phul ba'i 'dren mchog rnam gnyis la sogs te gong ma rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs nas de dag gi byin brlab rgyud la 'jug pa zhig byung na 'di dang phyi ma gang du'ang bde bar gda' bas de bzhin rim gyis bgyis phebs ltar/ thog mar logs bris skyon rigs la arga'i cho ga yang dag par mdzad pa'i nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu bka' bstsal gyi steng / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba/ yab rje dam pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi dri bsung 'thul ba/ de dag la bzhugs gdan/ dbu bsnyel na bza'/ steng du gos bzang bsgrigs kyi bla bre phyogs kun khyab pa/ gdung khebs/ 'phan/ sa rgyan la dril bu sogs/ phyag cha cha tshang re/ sbug sil cha kha yar/ ting bdun tshar me dam/ mar me 'khor mor 'bul ba sogs mdzad skabs/ gser phib sngar las tho gang tsam gyis mtho ba bkod pa'i zangs 'gebs skabs bzo rigs pa dag gis zangs kyis phyed tsam e ldang gsar brdung dgos tshul zhus par rnam 'dren 'di nyid kyi gsung las gsar brdung mi dgos pa nged kyis khag 'khur bas zangs bkab pa'i mthus gnang ba ltar bkab pa'i da lta mig ldan kun gyi gzigs gsal ltar gyur pa ni 'di lags shing / 'di'i gser 'phru'i rtse ma'i nang gzhug rnams rje dam pa 'di nyid rang gis phyag bzhes gnang ba'i nang gzungs byin rlabs can dang / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos srid chab srid yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin bcol 'dod gsol yang dag par mdzad rjes pho brang bzhi thog tu phebs skabs gra phyi em jis dkar gang shin tu dngos gtsang ba zhig dang dar dkar ring ba gcig

dngul srang lnga/ gser gyi ljang pa rdum gcig gos yug dmar po gcig rnams phyag tu 'byor bas thugs dgyes te chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i zhabs la lhag par dad pa'i mar me'i rgyun 'di de skabs nas 'bul bar mdzad pa yin/ zhes bshad pa ltar yin la/ 'on kyang de skabs kyi sku 'dra rme ba can la 'dra bzhes gsar bzhengs de nyid dang / a mes zhabs kyi sku de da lta g.yu thog gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa 'di nyid yin la/ phyis su bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po rdo rje 'chang rat+na'i mtshan can de nyid dgung grangs bcu bzhir phebs pa sa khyi lor gser 'bum bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi gser phib mdog 'don shing cha gsar spo/ gtsug lag khang phyi rgyar nyams gso gang dgos gnang mod/ snga sor gog stobs ches pa dang / sa yul yang chu 'gros kyis mi brling ba bcas lo re gnyis 'khyol ba las sra thang zhig ma byung 'dug pas snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gong ma de dag gi gdung rgyud khyad par can du skye skal bzang po thob kyang / lugs gnyis yon tan gyi cha nas zhabs 'og rdul phran gyi dod kyang mi 'pher ba sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang / ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug gnyis la mi theg mdzo khal be'us 'khur dgos kyi rnam thar shar skabs gdan sa chen po'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gang sar rang skal tshang ma dkon mchog thugs zhe mi khrel ba bgyid mur/ chu mo bya lor gtsug lag khang 'di nyid la nyams gso bgyis tshul ni/ spyir bla ma gong ma rim can gyi phyag nas phog pa'i rten rnams la zhig bzo mi rung mod/ 'on kyang rgyud sde rin po che du ma'i dgongs pa rgya bod mkhas grub rnams kyis bkral ba'i arga'i cho ga rnams las chung ngu chen por gtong ba dang / ngan pa bzang por spo ba/ 'o brgyal pa nas bzhugs gnas khyad par can du spyan drangs pa sogs la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa ma zad/

ma 'ongs lung bstan rnams las kyang / bde skyid kyi gnad khyad par can la bzhengs pa'i rten brten par nyams gso rab gnas bskyar na bstan 'gro la phan thogs par gsungs pa bzhin/ 'phags bod paṇa grub rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rim par byon pa rnams kyis kyang / nyams pa gso ba dang / gsar bskrun mdzad pa'i lo rgyus shin tu mang bar bzhugs pas gtsug lag khang rten bcas nyams gso bgyis pas bstan 'gro la gnod dogs mi 'dug kyang / snyigs dus 'gro ba kha mang don chung rnams kyi mos ngo dang mthun par nyams gso zhus pa legs min dkon mchog blos bkal gyi brtag sgril zhus par/ nyams gso bgyi ba bzang thon byung ba bzhin/ nged rang nas rje btsun grags pa dang / kun mkhyen go rams pa'i gsung rab bzhin rnying pa gsar spo'i arga'i cho ga yang dag par zhus te phyi nang tshang mar rtsa ba nas bzhengs pa'i zhabs tog zhus skabs nag phyogs la dga' ba dag gi cho 'phrul lta bus bzo las pa kha shas las nad kyis mnar ba sogs mi 'tshams pa 'dra zhig shar yang / rang gi go don la/ shākya thub pa'i skyes rabs sogs lo rgyus tshad ldan dag las bstan 'gro la phan pa'i bgyi ba zhig brtsams na/ de la 'dod pa'i dbang phyug sogs nag phyogs stobs chen rnams kyis cho 'phrul ya nga ba'i sgo nas 'jig rten pa rnams kha drangs te de las bzlog par gsungs shing / mdo las kyang / rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / /zhes gsungs pa mngon du gyur snyam zhing / gzhan yang lha rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi mthu las/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing sa gzhi 'tshub mas dben pa sogs spyir btang la legs tshogs che yang / ri klung gi rtswa dang zhing rnams la sos tshad kyis nyen shin tu che rung / bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje rtswa 'bru gnyis char la de lo sger du skyon ci yang ma byung ba sogs phyi 'byung ba rnams cha snyoms shing / nang du shes ldan gzur gnas rnams sa rdo shing sogs las yos stobs chen rnams la sgo gsum 'jug pa chig sgril rang bzhin gyis grub pa sogs/

mdor na sngon gyi ngag rgyun du/ /bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub/ /ces zer ba dang cha 'drar byung ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid brling khyad zhal lho gzigs su bsgyur/ sa 'bum gser dngul sogs rin po che las grub par bgyis pa 'di nyid kyi thig rtsa thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung la/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsung mchan mdzad pa de nang bzhin dang / mchod rten sgrub chog thun mong ma yin pa bu ston yab sras/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub bcas kyi yig steng nas lag len rnam par dag pa bsgrubs shing sngon gyi phyag len la dri med rnam gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs tshe rdo shing ras gang rung la chu tshon gyis 'bri bar mdzad kyang / 'di skabs su nged rang nas spros khyad gsar bcos lta bus dkyil 'khor gnyis char blos blangs su grub pa zhig lha bzo dbu rnying tshul khrims bkra shis la ngag bkod bgyis te chags tshad dang ldan par bzhengs shing / de gras 'od zer dri med dkyil 'khor dbus nas srog shing thon dgos pas dkyil 'khor kyang lhu sgrig chog bgyis pa 'di la 'gal ba med pa ni gser zangs kyi blos blangs la gzhi lhas pas rtogs sla shing / dkyil 'khor so sor nged rang nas rab gnas sgrub mchod sum cu la nyung mtha' byas pa song ba 'di dag gtsor gyur gyi zhabs bar dbu gsum gyi gzungs bzhugs tshul la/ mchod rten gyi sa khrir nged rang nas bsgrubs pa'i klu bum dgu/ sa 'dzin nas seng khri'i phyed tsam bar shing sgam dres zhogs rtsi ma rdo chal sgrigs rnams su gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bang mdzod bzhugs tshul la thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos kun blo mched la bstsal ba'i nor bu'i rigs zhig dang ṭaṃ rnying mda' gzhu ma/

nged rang mched kyis bsam gtan khang bu dang phyag gnyer gzhung nas phul gras/ dngul dkar gyi bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ gser zho sum cu kha yar/ dngul srang lnga bcu kha yar/ g.yu/ mu tig byi ru/ spos shel/ g.yang tri/ dung / mchong / mu men/ gzi/ nya lcib/ zangs lcags/ shel sogs rin po che'i thum/ gos jus dkar yug sogs yug bco lnga kha yar/ kha sman byang dar ling sogs kyi phon dkar yug sogs ras cha sna tshogs/ 'go snam bod snam sogs snam rigs/ ja mar shing 'bras/ sman sna/ tshwa nas 'bras gro sran sogs 'bru sna stobs che ba/ gzhan yang rol sil ting shags/ dkar yol 'bras shel yu ring sogs 'jig rten gyi dngos po ci 'byor gyis sgam rnams phyur bur bkang ba'i steng / dbyu gu ma'i 'bru 'phel 'khor lo dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo gsar bris che legs nged rang nas nus can du bsgrubs pa nor 'khrul med par bkram pa'i steng gdan sa'i par ma la 'dra len gyi pad gzungs tshang ma gser bris tshar gcig dang pad gzungs par ma so so nas phye sum brgyar nyung mtha' byas la/ de nas bang rim bzhi pa bar gser 'bum rnying pa nas byon pa'i sa tsha che chung sna tshogs dbu zhabs ma log par 'bru'i phung po spungs pa lta bu/ bum ldir gyi smad phyogs na gtsug tor dri med kyi dkyil 'khor dang bar thog bkab pa'i stod phyogs na 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i rten gtso so so'i gzungs gzhug la 'phags chen de nyid kyi phyag tu g.yas ru nas byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel/ ga ra 'jong nas byung ba'i ring bsrel/ gra thang nas byung ba'i ring bsrel rnams dang / gtso 'khor thams cad la so so'i gzungs/ dkyil 'khor de dag la so so'i mchod pa 'os 'tshams dang / spyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rgyal mtshan mtshan nyid can gyis bskor ba'i phyi nas srung 'khor ras bris ma gur zlum phub pa lta bu'i phyir shing skyor gyi brling cha bcas/

des ma khengs pa'i sa stong bum ldir na gser 'bum rnying pa nas byon pa'i smri ta'i phyag btab ma 'dra ba'i thub dbang bdun cu kha yar/ sngar gyi gtsug lag khang rnying mar 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi ldebs bris 'od dpag med kyi sku lnga brgya kha yar bzhengs par mdzad pa rnams kyi tshab nged rang nas lag btab 'od dpag med sku lnga brgya kha yar dang / bar gzungs rgyud sde bzhi rags bsdus dang / khyad par gzungs chen sde lnga gser bris ma res thog drangs par cha brgya phrag lhag nges/ sgrib sel gyi gzungs phon che ba/ 'gro la bde skyid ma sogs 'dod gsol gsar rnying sna mang gser 'bum gzungs rnying gras rdo rje gur gyi rgyud/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ sdud pa tshar gnyis/ gsung ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams skya chos rngo chos 'dres ma'i shog khrod la 'phags pa rin po che'i sku brgya bris ma mtshar ba/ nged rang nas dri med rnam gnyis kyi gzhung bzhin bsgrubs pa'i sa tsha chung ngu gzungs can brgya phrag brgal ba/ de dag gi rten gyi gtso bor thub pa'i dbang sku gser zangs ma che legs shig bzhugs pa 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi 'phags pa rin po che'i rnam thar las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de nas sku gdung zhugs la phul bas/ bla ma 'di mnga' thang shin tu che ba la brten nas gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs pa/ rgya bod kyi bar la yang yang 'byon 'grul sogs lugs gnyis kyi gnang skyong ches che ba'i khral 'u lag sogs la mi sde skal dman rnams ma dad pa'i dam tshig gi nyes pa cung zad kyi rnam pas gdung rus phal cher nag por byung zhing / de'i tshe slob dpon grags pa gzhon nu bya ba 'jam dbyangs sngon por grags pas gdung khang zhal ma phye ba la drung du phyin nas/ rang nyid kyi dbu zhal ba la brdab ste yus pa'i tshul du gsol ba drag tu btab pas/

gdung khang gi seng bug gcig nas sol ba rdog po gcig 'phur byung ba la/ de brad pas phyag gi mthe bong gi tshigs kyi gdung rus gcig la khab phra mo tsam gyi rigs lnga bzhengs sku'i rnam pa tsam byon pa slar yang gsol ba btab pas zhal phyag rgyan la sogs pa shin tu gsal bar byon/ de nyid shang grud kyi dgon pa rin chen mdzod kyi lha khang na slob dpon grags gzhon gyi nang rten thub pa'i sku'i nang na bzhugs so zhes kyang grags shing / yang lo rgyus gzhan las phyis 'ga' zhig gis gdung de bzhugs pa'i sku de bshas nas deng sang rgya mtsho ba'i lag na yod par gsung mod kyang gdung rus ngo mtshar can de nyid bzhugs pa'i thub dbang gi sku lha khang chen mo'i 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag dang bzo rgyun mthun pa rkang gang pa'i tshad tsam pa 'khrul med de nyid/ bar skabs su lha sa rdzong pa'i lag tu 'khyar ba/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog gi phyag tu byung nas smin 'gror bzhugs pa de nyid dus phyis sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gi lag tu rtsol med du byung ba 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sku 'dra rin po che de nyid 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang phyug gis gzhi thog dbang khang smin grol bde can gyi rten gral gyi gras su mdzad pa de nyid mchod rten 'dir gzungs 'bul gyi tshe pad gdan 'dod gsol gyis mtshan zhing na bza' bcas dang / yang 'phags pa rin po che'i sku 'dra phyag nas ma/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po dang / rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gnyis kyis sku tshe hril por byes khyer mdzad pa'i thugs dam rten tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor byin can rnams 'dod gsol bcas bzhugs su gsol ba'i mthar bzang gos spus legs kyi yol ba dang bar thog gnyis la bzang gos spus legs kyi bla bre shar ldan re re/ bre nang na/ rdo rje klu 'jim gyi thub dbang /

byams mgon/ slob dpon srin thod ma/ grub chen bir+wa pa/ a ti sha'i par sku phyag nas ma/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i leb par 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi phyag nas ma/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku rnams so so'i phyag nas ma/ phyi rten skor la/ sa 'bum gzungs rnying gras/ rje btsun sku mched/ sa paṇa rnams kyi dbu skra dang / rje btsun grags pa'i pur rus/ 'phags pa'i gdung tsha sum cu so bdun rnams dngul gyi spar bu ngo mtshar can du bzhugs pa/ gsar phul dam rdzas skor la/ dkar po rnam gsum/ sa paṇa rnams kyi sil bu so so nas lnga bcu nga gcig re/ 'phags pa'i sil bu brgya tham pa/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi khri rdo'i dum bu/ sa lo'i sil bu nga gcig grol mchog khri rdo'i dum bu/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags kyi sil bu gcig sngags 'chang chen po'i sil bu dgu bcu go bdun/ bcu rdo gsum/ bsod nams dbang po'i sil bu nyer gcig grags pa blo gros kyi bcu rdo lnga/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi stong rdo'i dum bu/ a mes zhabs yab sras gnyis kyi stong rdo gsum re/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas kyi dam rdzas dum bu/ rtse gdong bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po'i dam rdzas dum bu/ rje sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi sil bu bcu bdun/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi stong rdo lnga/ sil bu sum brgya dang gcig rje tshul khrims dpal bzang gi sil bu lnga/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi sil bu stong dang bdun/ bcu rdo lnga/ brgya rdo bdun/ stong rdo lnga/ khri rdo gcig bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi zhal nas bdud rtsi ril bu'i stong rdo rlon par byon pa'i dum bu rnams/ yang na bza' sogs kyi skor la/

'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i na bza'/ mar pa'i sku ber/ sa chen gar chas dang na bza'/ rje btsun grags pa'i na bza' dang phyag khug kha che paṇa chen gyi dbu zhwa/ sa paṇa sku sked/ 'phags pa'i dbu bsnyen/ dbu zhwa/ sku chos/ sku ber/ chos rje bla ma'i sku chos/ bu ston sku chos/ gtsang pa rgya ras pa'i na bza'/ ye shes rgyal mtshan pur ras/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ rong ston/ paṇa chen nags rin/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug rnams kyi na bza'/ kha'u bdag chen zhabs yu/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo dkon mchog lhun grub rnams kyi na bza'/ sangs rgyas seṅge'i pur ras/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyi sku sham/ tshar chen na bza' sku rags/ 'a zhwa nam mkha' don grub kyi pur chas phying pa/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug na bza'/ yol gzhon nu blo gros sku rags/ bsod nams bzang po'i na bza'/ dbang phyug rab brtan dbu zhwa/ na bza'/ gzim thul/ zhabs yu/ pur ras/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi na bza'/ a mes zhabs kyi na bza' phur dar/ shangs phyis/ bsod nams dbang phyug na bza'/ kun dka' bkra shis kyi na bza' dang phur dar te 'di rnams kyi dum bu re/ 'brog mi dang sa paṇa gyi pur thal/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa'i pur rus/ theg chen sku sha dang pur thas pur sol/ ngor chen dang rgyal tshab dam pa'i pur thal/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu thod dang pur thal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gdung rus/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags kyi pur tsha/ sangs rgyas seṅge'i pur thal ril bu/ sngags 'chang chen po'i dbu thod/ zhun thigs/ chab ser ril bu/ dkon mchog dpal ldan dang tshar chen gyi pur rus/ mkhyen brtse'i pur rus ril bu/ yol gzhon nu blo gros kyi pur tsha/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi pur rus/ chab ser ril bu/ pur tsha/ sgar chen dbu thod/

klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/ a mes zhabs kyi gdung rus/ thugs kyi dum bu/ zhabs sen/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas dang / bka' 'gyur ba'i pur rus/ bsod nams dbang phyug gi pur rus gdung thal/ ka ye bstan pa rab rgyas dbu thod/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi dbu thod sku mtshal/ zhun thigs te de rnams kyi dum bu sne 'dus/ yang dkar po rnam gsum/ sa paṇa/ ngor chen/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug shes rab rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan bkra shis/ sa lo/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chen po/ 'doms thog bdag chen kun dga' legs pa/ tshar chen bsod nams dbang po/ thar rtse paṇa chen/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ lcags zam 'gyur med bde chen/ ngag dbang chos grags/ a mes zhabs yab sras/ bstan pa rab rgyas bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhyen brtse rab brtan rnams kyi dbu lo/ yang byang sems chos 'phags dang / sangs rgyas kyi chibs pa ngang pa gser ldan gyi tshems/ slob dpon chen po dang mtsho rgyal gyi phyag bris gter shog ril bu a rgya ma/ jo bo rje'i phyag tsha dang / phyag nas/ nā ro'i rus rgyan/ a mes dam pa'i tshems/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter shog bla ma dam pa'i thugs dam gtor ma/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi mgon pod me 'bar pu sti dngos kyi thum/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang sgar chen gyi phyag phreng / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi rnam rgyal gzungs ring khri tshar mdzad dus kyi mthor nas/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis dang / yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi phyag nas/ jo bo shākya mu ner khrus gsol bum chu zan ril/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang / yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dhīḥyig ril bu/ thang stong rgyal po la tshe dpag med kyis dngos su gnang ba'i tshe ril/

mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi skye bdun ril bu/ bka' 'gyur ba'i rten 'dus ril bu/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi grub rgyal ril bu sogs gsar rnying ril sna shin tu mang ba ste de rnams so so nas phran bu re/ gdung tsha'i skor la/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ kun dga' dbang phyug rnams kyi gdung tsha mchod dgu ma/ lha mchog seng ge'i gdung 'dam la rnam rgyal mchod rten/ dkon mchog dpal ldan gdung 'dam la 'jam dbyangs/ bsod nams dbang phyug gdung 'dam la tshe dpag med drug 'jam dbyangs gnyis/ sgrol ljang bdun/ kun dga' bkra shis kyi gdung 'dam la bsod nams dbang phyug gsum/ de nyid rang gi sku dgu/ tshe dpag med gsum/ rnam rgyal/ sgrol dkar/ 'jigs byed rnams re re/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi gdung 'dam la sa paṇa gsum/ rje nyid kyi sku drug thang stong rgyal po gcig 'jigs byed dang / ma 'joms gsum re/ sgrol ljang gcig yongs 'dzin brag rtsa ba'i gdung 'dam la slob dpon/ sa paṇa/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang / mi 'khrugs pa/ drag mthing / 'jigs byed/ 'jam dbyangs rnams re re/ tshe dpag med bzhi/ yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gdung 'dam la/ rdo rje 'chang / thub dbang / rta mgrin skyer sgang / spyan ras gzigs/ gdugs dkar phyag gnyis/ ri khrod ma/ sgrol dkar ma/ phyag rdor/ rje nyid kyi sku rnams re re/ dam rdzas sman 'dam las grub pa'i slob dpon/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa chen/ sa paṇa/ thang stong rgyal po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkha' spyod ma/ 'jigs byed/ 'od dpag med/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar/ mchod dgu ma rnams dang / sman 'dam las grub pa'i tshe dpag med gnyis/ 'dam thog rten 'dam/ rten 'dam dpe la nged rang gi dkar chag nang bzhin bcas bzhugs/ chos 'khor la rgyud sde bzhi rags bsdus/ sdom gsum gur zhal rnams kyi bla rgyud so so nas brgya phrag brgal ba/

dri med rnam gnyis/ gong ma lnga'i dbu bla/ grub chen brgyad cu/ dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs mtshan byang rnams gser bris ma re re/ srog shing rtser 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs mdo yug bris/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs/ dngul gyi za ma tog chung ngu'i nang gzungs rnying gras rgya yul nas byung ba'i ring bsrel/ sa paṇa gyi ring bsrel bzhi sogs dang / tog la gdugs dkar gyi 'khor lo dang tsakli bcas bzhugs su gsol nas de la brten pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs chog kyang bgyis shing / dbu zhabs bar gsum gyi gzungs rnams kyi srub 'tshangs su dri bzangs shug phye phon che ba la ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dbyangs sku mtshal ril bu/ rtswa kun bzang sogs rgya bod gnas chen rnams kyi sa sna rdo sna gtsang ma sna tshogs bsres pas phyur bur gtams te bzhugs pa lags/ de lta bu'i sku gdung rin po che de nyid kyi phyi nas rin po che'i na bza' phra rgyan sogs gsol ba'i dngos po du song bkod par rgya dngul srang dgu brgya lnga bcu nga gnyis zho bcu gnyis skar ma bcu/ gser mgur zho lnga brgya dang bcu gsum pa drug zangs khal brgya dang bcu nyag drug spor do/ rtsi rgyu dngul srang bcu gcig dang zho drug rtsi zangs khal gnyis nyag drug spor do/ dngul chu rgya thur gyi srang bdun brgya dang bcu gnyis/ te tsha khal gcig nyag bco lnga/ star bu khal gcig nyag bcu gcig spor gang / tshwa sa bre bdun/ spos dkar nyag do/ rin po che dang gos dar gyi rgyan skor zhib par deb na gsal zhing / 'dir rags rim tsam bkod na/ shel kha dog dang dbyibs sna tshogs brgya dang zhe brgyad skor/ spyi khebs g.yu khra ma bco brgyad skor/ dngul ga bzhi/ gser pad bcu bdun skor/ dpral g.yu nyer dgu skor/ skong sna bco lnga skor/ byi ru che chung sna tshogs sdom dgu brgya bcu gnyis skor/ mu men mu 'dra dbyibs sna tshogs bdun brgya drug bcu re dgu skor/

nya lcibs nyis brgya bcu drug skor/ spos shel che chung sna tshogs drug brgya drug cu re lnga skor/ g.yu/ mchong / g.yang tri/ mu tig sogs rdog grangs kha shas/ rin chen zhum mig dang dbyig gcig dar gos bzang po sna tshogs yug bcas kyis legs par spras pa'i gdung rten 'di nyid bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi ldebs bris la/ bdag cag gi ston pa la gnas brtan bcu drug gnas g.yog sbyin bdag bcas kyis bskor ba dang / sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang byams pa rnams zhing khams so so'i rten gtsor bzhugs pa la/ tshe dpag med/ rnam rgyal/ sgrol dkar/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ ā tsar+ya pad+ma kā ra/ sad mi mi bdun/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ chos rje bla ma/ theg chen/ bdag chen kha'u pa/ sa lo/ sngags 'chang chen po/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang / nged rang mched bcas kyi dbu bla tshang ma/ bde chen zhing bkod/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ blon po thu mi dang mgar lha btsun khu dbon/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsan/ rwa lo rdo rje grags/ ngor rdzong tshar gsum/ 'phags pa rin po che'i sbyin bdag chen po se chen go se la yum sras/ rgyal chen bzhi/ nged rang mched 'khor bcas sbyin bdag gi tshul du bkod pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar nged rang la chung ngu'i dus su rmi ltas ya mtshan can byung ba'i bkod pa rnams dang / ka gdung shing brtsegs rten de dag gi bar mtshams dang gsham bcas la bkra shis pa'i ri mo ngo mtshar can dang / tshon mdangs bzang zhing gser shog sogs kyis ngo mtshar bar spud par grang gser mgur zho brgyad/ gser shog phreng ma brgya bam nyis brgya nyer brgyad/ dngul shog brgya bam dgu/ mtshal sa 'degs kyi khal gsum nyag gang spor gang / mthing nyag bco brgyad dang spor gsum/ spang ma 'degs khal drug dang nyag bcu drug spor gsum/

dkar reg nyag bco lnga spor do/ /grog tshag bre brgyad/ li khri rgya thur gyi srang dgu dang zho brgyad/ lha dbang rtse'i btsag khal gcig bre bdun/ bab bla nyag dgu spor do/ g.yu kha khal gnyis nyag brgyad spor gang / rgya tshes bre bdun/ ram 'degs nyag drug dang spor gang / bu ram nyag bcu/ sbrang nyag gsum/ bsra rtsi drug phing phyed do bcas song zhing / dngul gdung rin po che'i g.yas g.yon la rten khri 'khor lo'i steng dpal sa skya'i gdan rabs rin po che'i sman sku bzo khyad can bzhugs pa 'di rnams kyi sku rgyu la/ chos rje mus srad pas lam 'bras bla brgyud bzhengs tshul las/ bla ma so so'i bzhugs gnas sku 'bum sogs kyi sa dang / gsol chu/ sgrub chu/ bum chu sogs 'dres na byin rlabs che bar gsungs pa bzhin/ 'khon sku 'bum/ dpal chen pho brang / bra 'o lung phu mda'/ ba ri phyi rten/ g.yu mkhar mo/ 'phru ma/ sku 'bum rnam rgyal/ bla brang shar pa chen phug dbu rtse mdo phug rtse mo'i gdung thal las grub pa'i mchod rten/ phyi rten/ mkha' spyod la gshegs dus kyi bzhugs khri zhabs rjes can/ rtse mo phug rje btsun rin po che'i phyogs bzhi'i phug chen/ sgo rum dpe khang / spyod yul phug sgo rum ltag sa paṇa gyi thugs gnyer bzhugs khri/ ngam ring rtag bde klu khung / 'phags pa phug lha khang bla brang g.yu thog sku 'bum/ shing khang bla brang / bla brang shar tong / gzhi thog skya rnying / rin sgang bla brang / gzim khang 'brug ris ma/ byas 'gyur bla brang shar nub/ skyed lhas sum cu rtsa gsum/ lha khang rtse po ta la/ phu ri byang chub rdzong dang glang brag gzhi thog rtse'i bsam 'grub skyid pa/ 'bum thang na bzhugs pa'i phyi rten so so'i sa sna gtsang ma/ ga ya rda ra'i bum chu/ 'jam chu/ nang so chu mig chu mig rdzing kha/ mda' chu/ bla brang shar sgrub chu/ byas 'gyur gsang ba'i sgrub chu/ 'phru ma'i sngags 'chang sgrub chu/

bsam brling chu sna/ sgrol ma'i khron chu/ ngam ring / sa chen pur thal mtshor sbyangs kyi chu/ g.yas ru gtsang chu/ rten 'dam dpe grags ma/ sman sna kun 'dus/ rin chen kun 'dus/ dri bzang rnams 'jim pa bzang por bsres pa'i rgyu las grub pa'i rten gtso 'jam dbyangs sa chen gyi zhal gzigs nang bzhin dang / bla ma so so'i sku brnyan rnams mngon rtogs yig rnying du zhal gsal ba ltar dang / mi gsal ba rnams so so'i rnam thar nas 'byung ba'i sku na'i bgres gzhon gyi babs dang bstun 'dra nyams can du bzhengs te bzhugs su gsol ba'i g.yas bstar la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ shrī dharma pha la rak+ṣi ta/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ ta dbon blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gzhi thog kun dga' dbang phyug bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen/ sems dpa' chen po grags pa blo gros/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag bhu su ku sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams so/ /g.yon bstar la ba ri lo tsā ba chen po rin chen grags pa/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ta dbon kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/

rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ grub mchod bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa a mes zhabs/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bkra shis/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams so/ /de lta bu'i sku brnyan khyad par can de dag la stod smad bar gsum gyi chos sku'i ring bsrel tshang ma/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i mtha' brten bcas bzhugs shing / rten gtso 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung bcu/ sa paṇa gyi gdung thal ring bsrel/ khyung po'i thugs las byon pa'i ring bsrel/ mchod rten bye ba ma/ klu 'jim las grub pa'i thub dbang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba/ rgya gar li ma'i 'jam dbyangs phyag bzhi pa/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gcig sku 'di rnams la 'bul rgyu'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sgrub pa grol 'phral lag 'byor byung ba'i gser dngul dkar yol 'bru bzang pos bkang ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po nas bzung gdan rabs tshang mar de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gnyis re dang khyung po sogs bla ma gong ma'i 'phel gdung re re/ rten thams cad la bla ma gong ma'i dbu skra na bza'/ pur thal phyag nas/ dam rdzas tshe ril/ gdung tsha/ dam rdzas sman sku sogs dngul gdung rin po cher bzhugs pa cha 'dra'i ring bsrel rnam bzhi sne 'dus dang / 'khon dkon mchog rgyal por sman sku de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma nged rang nas kī la ya'i bsnyen sgrub grol dus phur lcog bla ma byams pa'i phyag nas byung ba/ ba ri bar rdo nag las grub pa'i seṅge'i gdong can gyi sku de nyid rang gi thugs dam ma lcags shubs gser tshags rgya bzo ma bcas/ sa chen la bir+wa pa'i sku li dmar rje btsun grags pa'i thugs dam ma/ rtse mor kyai rdor li ma rje btsun ma nyid kyi sman sku phyag nas ma/

sa paṇa la nyid kyi li sku phyag nas ma/ 'phags pa rin po che nyid kyi sman sku hor bzo phyag nas ma/ chos rje bla ma nyid kyi sman sku hor bzo phyag nas ma/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan la nyid kyi sku ba so las grub pa phyag nas ma/ sa lor nyid kyi sku tsan 'dam las grub pa phyag nas ma/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ a mes zhabs yab sras dbon gsum/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang rnams la so so'i sman sku phyag nas ma re re/ sbyin bdag mched gnyis la spyi sgos bstan pa rgyas shing skye 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'dod gsol rgyas pa'i mthar bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi thugs bskyed smon lam sbyar ba'i pod chung re re bcas bzhugs pa'i sku rnams la bzang gos las grub pa'i rgyab yol/ bzhugs gdan/ na bza' sku pang bcas dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa'i phyag phreng rin po che dbang mdangs can/ sgar chen phyag phreng dbang mdangs can/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag phreng yin nges su yin ngo ma 'phrod gras shel phreng / ko rlon rtse/ rag phreng gcig rnams dang / a mes zhabs kyi phyag phreng nya lcibs/ yab rje dam pa'i phyag phreng shel dkar/ gong dkar chos rje blo gros dbang phyug gi phyag phreng bo tsita/ nged rang chung dus kyi phreng ba shel dang byu ru/ yang nged rang spun gyi phreng ba hor shel dang rak+ṣa rnams kyis thog drangs sku tshang mar mgul phreng re re/ rten de rnams kyi drung du bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge sa skyong sku mched la 'di nas dngos phul dge bskul zhus pa'i rdor dril theg chen 'dra cog spus legs gser mgo ma sum cu so gnyis dang / 'thor snod re re/ gzhan yang mchod cha'i skor la bkra shis rdzas brgyad che legs kyi me long / bir+wa/ dūr ba/ dung rnams ngo ma dang / de phyin gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyur zangs ljon bsdoms sa 'degs kyi khal sum cu dang nyag drug spor do/

gser mgur zho brgya dang dgu bcu go brgyad/ se ba bcu bdun/ dngul chu sa 'degs kyi khal gcig nyag drug dngul srang bcu bzhi dang zho dgu skar lnga/ ti tsha sa 'degs kyi khal gcig nyag bzhi spor gsum/ rtsi rgyur dngul srang nyer brgyad rnams las grub pa/ nged rang mched kyi lag tu gzhung zhabs rin po che nas bstsal ba'i dngul mdong dngul phor ja ma bum sogs kha shas/ yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge rgyal khab chen po nas bstsal ba'i dngul bum 'phra ma spus ldan kha rgyan bzo khyad can cha/ yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag khal kha dang / 'ur du su sogs dpon khag rnams kyis byin pa'i dngul dang zangs gser zangs kyi maṇ+ḍal kha shas/ gsar bzo rgya dngul srang brgya dang lnga las grub pa'i bdun tshar/ dngul kong rgya dngul srang bdun cu don lnga las grub pa 'phra ldan bcas kyi thog drangs dngul spyad kha shas/ dkar spyad sogs mchod rdzas ngo mtshar can mang ba/ bzang gos kyi bla bre/ ka 'phan phye phur sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan te kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi steng na gser zangs kyi rgya phub che legs gsar bzo'i rgyur rgya phub rnying pa'i zangs rnams phyogs gcig bsdoms pa la khal sum brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu nyag bdun spor do/ de steng zangs gser 'phar ba khal nyis brgya dang nyer bzhi nyag bdun/ gser 'bum rnying pa'i grang gser zhib chags kyis zhus par 'gur zho bcu/ rgya phub rnying pa'i tsha gser bshus par gser zho zhe gnyis dang se ba bcu bdun/ de phyin gser song tshang ma bsdoms 'gur zho nyis stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu zhe gsum se ba phye nyer bzhi/ dngul chu rgya thur gyi srang nyis stong nyis brgya dgu bcu go gcig star bu sa khal gsum dang nyag bcu drug spor do/ tshwa sa khal gnyis dang bre bcu/ ti tsha sa nyag bcu bzhi/ rtsi rgyur zangs khal gnyis nyag dgu/

dngul srang nyer brgyad dang zho lnga/ phyi nang gi shan sogs kyi rgyur lcags 'degs sa khal bdun cu don gsum nyag drug spor gang bcas song zhing / gser tog gañji rar dbu zhabs bar gsum gyi gzungs cha tshang / sa chen gyi li sku/ gdugs dkar gyi sku dang 'khor lo/ tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dod gsol rgyas pa bcas bzhugs so/ /de lta bus gdung rten rin po che 'di nyid bsgrubs pa'i thog mar nged rang nas gtsug tor dri med kyi bsnyen pa zla gcig ring bgyis par gzungs thung 'bum/ gzungs ring stong / 'od zer dri med dang rjes 'brel sgrib sel gyi gzungs khri tshar/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sngon 'gro nor rgyun ma'i gzungs grangs mang bcas bgyis te/ gong bkod mchod rten sgrub chog thun mong ma yin pa de dag lag len du btab pa'i mthar/ sa phur/ kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs rnams la brten pa'i rab gnas rgyas pa dang / yi dam gyi lha du ma la brten pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa grangs mang du bgyis shing / de dag gi gnas skabs su gza' skar 'phrod sogs legs 'dzom rang 'grig dang gnam sa bar gsum gyi rtags mtshan legs shing rmi ltas su'ang rje btsun rin po che'i phyi rten sku 'bum sa phyogs 'di nyid na bzhugs pa'i bum ldir nang gtsug lag khang bkod legs zhig na bla ma gong ma'i byin rten du ma bzhugs zer ba'i gos khug li khri grangs mang kyi khrod nas rje btsun rin po che dang sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi ring bsrel kha shas rnyed pa'i rmi ltas dang / yang nub gcig rgya mi gos bzang can sba dbyug thogs pa zhig dges nyams dang bcas hi hi ti ring ti ring ti ring zer ba'i sgra brjod pa zhig byung yang gang yin ji bzhin rang ha ma go yang ngan rtags min 'dra bas bkod pa yin zhing / gtsug lag khang sku 'bum bcas grub nas lo gcig tsam song mtshams gdan rabs sku 'dra rin po che gsar bzhengs rnams gtsug lag khang 'dir phebs nas ring po ma lon par nged rang mched/

mkhan po ban gtsang dpon slob bcu phrag tsam gyis kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas 'bring po phyi skor me tog 'thor ba/ 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag nas bzhugs pa'i khyad 'phags rin chen ston tshul ma zhal 'byed dang / de skabs kyi bya ba byed cing legs so ster ba sogs ser skya drag zhan rnams la dga' ston rgyas par spel te/ glu gzhas sogs bkra shis pa'i yan lag du ma dang bcas mthar phyin par bgyis te byin brlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar zhing dge legs kyi lhun por bzhugs pa 'di nyid yun ji tsam la grub sogs ni zhig gsos skor nged rang mched kyis ngag bkod bgyis pa bzhin mdzod pa shes rab phun tshogs kyi lag len du btab ste chu bya zla 7tshes 5nas bzung gtsug lag khang gi las grwa tshugs par 'go byed drung ser ngag dbang tshe brtan/ lha bzo 'go pa kun dga' rgya mtsho/ khang dpon kun dga' tshe ring / shing bzo dbu byed bkra shis phun tshogs/ dbu chung pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ chos sgron/ bsam pa don grub/ nor bu/ khyi lod/ phur pa rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin bcas dang / rdo bzo ba dar rgyas/ 'ba' ra/ so 'dzin/ yar 'phel/ mdzod steng bkra shis/ shar pa zla ba/ rdo chal ba/ rdo grong pa dang / ma chen rdor legs/ rkang shar dar dar dang kun dga' lhun grub bcas kyis las rgyun zla ba gnyis dang zhag bco lnga'i khongs gtsug lag khang mthar phyin dang / yang 'go pa drung ser ngag dbang tshe brtan/ kun dga' tshe ring gnyis/ shing bzo ba bcas gong gsal nas zla ba brgyad dang zhag bcu'i khongs rgya phub dang dngul gdung shing bsgrigs mthar phyin/ yang 'go pa ngag tshe dang rgya phub kyi zangs bzo shel dkar ba dbu byed lha btsan/ tshe ring dpal/ mgon po lha mo/ bsod nams mgon po/ rgyal stod/ rab brtan/ tshe gang dgra 'dul/ bre srang / ye le ba 'das gtsang / lha dbang / chos 'phel/ bar sbug pa dpon po don grub/ bsod nams bkra shis/

rtse gdong pa dbu byed bsam 'grub nor bu/ lcags phur/ skar ma/ bco lnga dang / yang bar sbug dbu byed o rgyan pha bu/ dbu byed bkra shis dbang / rab brtan/ bla ma phrin las/ bstan 'dzin/ dbang rgyal/ dpal mgon/ bal po dpal rgyal/ dharna pa ti/ tshags pa mgon dbang / 'od 'bar bcas kyis lo gcig zla ba gnyis zhag nyer bzhi'i khongs rgya phub sku 'bum rnams kyi gser dngul zangs bzo'i bgyi ba mthar phyin dang / yang lha dbu kun rgyal dang / tshul khrims bkra shis/ rab rgyas/ kun dga' dbang phyug zla 'od/ rgyal mtshan bsam 'grub/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ brtson 'grus rab rgyas/ bkra shis tshe brtan bcas kyis zla ba lnga dang zhag bcu'i khongs bris dang rtsi tshon tshang ma zin pa yin zhing / de skabs su dge rgyun zhal 'debs 'brel thogs thor/ nged rang mched kyi bsam gtan khong bu nas song ba rnams gdan sa gzhung khongs su 'thus pa las dmigs bsal bkod ma dgos shing / de phyin gyi byung tho/ rje btsun ma ṇi drung de nyid kyi sku chas thog nas gser mgur zho phye nyis brgya/ ma drung sku drin can bsod nams dpal gyi dbang mo de nyid nas spos shel rdog gnyis/ byu ru nyer dgu/ spos shel nar mo nyer bzhi/ byu ru nar mo nyer brgyad/ mu men nar mo so drug spos shel leb mo gnyis/ mchong nar mo gsum/ rdo mnye ma gsum/ g.yu pad gser mtha' ma spus legs cha/ a lce drung gnyis nas g.yu rdog gnyis/ mdzod pa shes rab phun tshogs kyi gser mgur zho nyer lnga/ dngul srang gsum/ gnyer khang gzhung nas zangs nyag bcu bzhi/ g.yu pad gser mtha' ma gnyis/ dngul chu thur srang brgyad dang zho dgu/ gnyer bsod nams mchog ldan gyi gser zho do/ zangs nyag bcu gnyis dang spor do/ ngor bla brang gzhung nas zangs khal bdun nyag bcu bzhi/ klu lding nas gser mgur zho bco lnga/ dngul chu thur srang gsum/ khang gsar nas gser zho bcu gsum dang se ba phyed bcu drug

gcen lung gnyer pa lhun gling pa dngul chu thur srang gsum/ gling kha drung chen dge phun nas gser zho gang / sgom chen brtson 'grus dang dkon mchog dpal ldan gnyis kyi gser zho re/ 'gag pa chos rje dngul chu srang gsum zho lnga/ bar sbug dpal mgon rdo rjes g.yu gcig bar sbug 'das pas ṭaṃ gsum/ rin chen lding pas ṭaṃ gcig yul lho smon lam rin chen gyi hor dkar rtsa ring legs pa gcig khab gsar spug pas zangs nyag gang spor gsum/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel spyi so nas zangs khal gcig nyag bcu gnyis/ bdud po dbu byed mas zangs nyag gang / chos ma phu sgrub chen gyi zangs nyag do/ bsam yas bla ma kun dga' bsam 'grub nas spos shel gnyis/ g.yu chung gnyis/ byu chung nyi shu/ gzi khra ril nar gnyis/ g.yang tri ril mo gcig ṭaṃ rnying gnyis/ dkar yol bar rnying yu ring gcig gdong dga' byams chos pas gser zho gang / nyi shar jo dgon bla mas zangs nyag bdun/ zho lung sgrub sde'i dbu byed 'gro gsal gyi zangs nyag gang spor do/ mgron gnyer kun bzang dbang po 'das shul nas gser pad legs pa gcig dang khrab hrul/ me mda'/ lcags glang / rting skyes dga' ldan rtse spyi so'i dngul srang gsum/ zhal lta ma chos 'dzin zangs nyag gang spor do/ chos dpal zangs nyag gang / chos ma sku gnyer rin chen chos 'phel gyi ṭaṃ bzhi/ gdong dga' chos sde spyi so'i zangs khal gcig nyag drug mda' ro pa zangs nyag drug spor do/ em chi zhal dkar ba'i gser pad gcig spos shel gcig byu ru gnyis/ gsol dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan g.yu mtha' dngul gyis byas pa gcig spyi chen bkra shis dpal bzang 'das shul nas dngul srang gsum dang zho bzhi skar lnga/ nag tshang bla ma sbyin pa 'das shul nas zangs nyag do spor gang / dngul zho phyed brgyad/ gzim dpon bsod nams 'od zer nas byu ru gnyis bcas dang / yang zangs bzo rdo shing 'ul mi bcas par mang ja skol shal 'phar du nged rang mched nas tshar gsum btang thog mi rer dar 'gyed tshar gnyis dang dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu gsum re/

rtsam 'gyed tshar gnyis/ yum drung nas mang ja skol shal tshar gsum dang rtsam dar gyi 'gyed/ a lce drung gnyis nas mang ja sko shal/ mdzod pa shes rab phun tshogs kyi mang ja skol shal tshar gsum dang rtsam dar gyi 'gyed/ gnyer bsod nams mchog ldan gyi mang ja skol shal rtsam gyi 'gyed/ gnyer tshang gzhung / gdong dga' chos sde/ chos lhun spyi pa/ bkra shis 'od zer/ kun dga' phun tshogs/ ngag dbang tshe brtan/ 'bum thang sku gnyer bsod nams yar 'phel rnams kyis mang ja skol shal re bcas dang / yang phyi nang gi zangs gad gser zangs gzi rgyag bcas la/ rin chen sgang pa bzang pa bdud po ba/ bde chen chos gling pa/ zhe lung sgrub sde/ se lung ba/ gzhis chen sgrub sde/ chos 'khor gling pa/ rtse dkar ba/ nor gling ba/ rgyal bzang pa/ shrī sbug pa/ kha ba lhas pa/ phu gsum pa/ dgon pa rgyas pa/ na ring sgrub sde ba/ ko chang bde chen chos gling pa/ chos sdings pa/ sa la ba/ rtsal khung pa/ ngang tshang pa/ brag nag pa/ chos lhun pa dang lte ra ba'i skra bcad bcas btsun ma kha grangs lnga brgya dang brgyad kyi las rgyun byings nas zhag nyi shu re dang rin chen sgang pas zla ba gcig dang zhag nyi shu bcas song ba nyin ltar mang ja gnyis re dang / ko shal char 'phar bzo byings dang 'dra ba/ rgyugs zhag thim bstun btsun ma rer rtsam pa bre re dngul skar phyed brgyad re dang btsun ma sum cu rer mang ja shag mtshal rgyab bcas re song zhing / gong gsal gyi bzo pa rnams la tshugs ston/ bar ston/ grol ston bcas ston mo rgya spom che ba tshar gsum re/ de steng so sor sba dar re/ ja mar chang sogs kyi gsol ras rgya che ba/ zla re bzhin gyi bco lnga gnam gang la ja mar sha chang sogs skabs sbyar re/ shel dkar zangs bzo ba rnams la gser phud rtsis gzhi ltar dngul srang bco lnga'i gtsos pa'i bcu gcig tshan gcig dang bar sbug par dngul srang phyed brgyad kyi gtsos dgu tshan gcig bcas song ba dang gong gsal gyi bzo 'go lag g.yog rkang shar ma chen bcas pa rnams la nyin ltar gnang cha gla thob rtsis gzhi ltar sprad pas 'gro song tshang ma bsdoms dngul phab kyi dngul srang stong dang sum cu phye so dgu thob par ja gos dar dngul bcas kyi khongs nas gun med du song zhing /

gzhan yang gong gi gzungs 'bul zhabs phyi zhu mi gsol gzim gnyis/ mchod dpon pa bcas la ja chung ju rdum bzhi/ dbus phrug dmar po bub gsum/ ko snam bub gnyis dang / khang dpon rta mgrin/ sgo ra ba/ bkras phun bcas la snam rgya thig bub gnyis/ ja bar rdum gsum/ rdo bzo rgyas/ 'ba' ra/ so 'dzin/ yar 'phel bcas la phyu sngon gcig sha gos rgya ma gnyis/ stod 'gag gcig ja bar rdum gcig tshul khrims bkra shis/ kun rgyam gnyis la ja bar rdum gcig zla 'od/ dbang phyug rgyan bsam/ dbu ma lags bcas la ja rdum gcig rnams kyang song zhing / de ltar bzhengs pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ lung rnam byed las/ kun dga' rwa ba gtsug lag khang / /mal ston 'tsho ba nar ma dang / /zhes sogs rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi gtso bo dge 'dun gyi sde dang / der gtsug lag khang dang / sku gzugs dang / glegs bam dang / mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams yin par gsungs shing / gnas mal gyi gzhi dang / gso sbyong gi gzhi las/ gtsug lag khang brtsig cing ri mor bri ba dang / mchod rten bzhengs tshul dang / sku gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad tshul dang / spong khang sgrub tshul dang / dge 'dun bsdus nas bstan pa'i bya ba byed tshul rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du/ sngon grub chen kaṃ bha la'am/ sa lu zhes bya bas kyang grub pa thob nas bstan pa la gang phan gzigs pas dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa las lhag pa med par gzigs nas rgyal por bsams bzhin du skye ba bzhes nas bi kra ma la'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas bstan pa la 'phel rgyas byung tshul gsungs pa ltar dang / jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti shas kyang / btsun pa rnam grol sde la sogs pa'i rjes su zhugs te rgya gar du gtsug lag khang du ma'i gnyer bdag mdzad cing / bod du 'brom ston chen po la yang / 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa la dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi bzhengs pa las lhag pa med pas gnas gzhi gyis shig ces gdams pas na/

rten gsum bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la yang phan yon dpag tu med cing / de dag gi nang du bzhugs pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa ni/ de dag pas kyang phan yon che ste/ de yang mchod rten gyi phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa'i mchod rten byed dam byed bcug pa/ /mya ngan 'joms dang lus kun sgrib pa dag /rin chen mdzod mang 'jig rten gtso 'gyur zhing / /mi de dgra yi tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la rgyu mtshan ci yod pa/ /de yi grangs rnyed de rnyed mi rnams kyi/ /lha yul sa steng rgyal srid nges par thob/ /gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting 'dzin dang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myong nas/ /mtha' mar skye rga na la sogs pa yi/ /sdug bsngal med pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phangs thob/ /ces dang / gzhan yang mdo du ma las/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag du ma dang bcas pa la lo grangs dpag tu med par yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs tshon gang pa ring bsrel gyi rnying po can zhig 'jim pa las bsgrubs pa bsod nams lhag pa sogs mang du gsungs shing / sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'di ni rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa ni/ /gzugs bzang skal bzang yon tan nye bar ldan/ /'di ni dbang po sbas dang nyi ma'i 'od/ /'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa gang / /de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang / /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs dang sdug bsngal bral/ /pad+ma'i nang bzhin 'jam dang yangs par gyur/ /'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa gang / /bran du mi 'gyur dbul po'i rang bzhin min/ /las byed ma yin skye ba dman pa min/ /dbang po ma tshang min te skyes mchog 'gyur/

/zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo dang / mar me 'bul ba'i mdo dang / mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs bcad la sogs pa na/ sku gzugs bzhengs pa la phan yon yod tshul rgyas par bzhugs shing / rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu bris sku sgrub tshul dang / bsgrubs pa la phan yon yod tshul mang du gsungs so/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas stobs bcu'i sku mnga' rnam 'dren dbang po sangs rgyas dang / /rnam grol yon tan skyed byed des gsungs 'khor ba'i skyon rnams kun sel dam pa'i chos/ /bslab gsum rin chen do shal gyis mdzes tshogs mchog skyabs gnas dge 'dun 'gyur med bden pa'i stobs/ /bka' sdod chos srung rdo rje'i ye shes spyan gyis kun tu bsrung zhing 'phral dang yun du bkra shis mdzod/ /ces 'bum thang dngul gdung rin po che byin rlabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi dkar chag snying por bsdus pa 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar zhing / spros pa la dga' na rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dgongs don rnams mkhas pa sngon ma du mas sdeb legs rtsom gyi phreng ba rgya cher spel ba du ma zhig dang lhag par rang lugs la 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas rnam bshad chen mo las rten gsum gyi rnam gzhag chags tshad bzhengs tshul phan yon sogs rgya cher bka' bstsal ba de dag kyang / dkar chag dmar bsdus 'di nyid kyi steng du spyan drangs pas mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad ngo mtshar can yong bar 'dug pas na shes ldan dag gis de bzhin rtogs par bya zhing / yang rten gyi rnam gzhag rags bsdus dang / khyad par dri med rnam gnyis kyi sgo nas mchod rten sgrub chog thun mong ma yin pa bgyis pa la phan yon yod tshul sogs nged rang nas brtsams pa'i mchod sdong 'dzam gling 'od gsal gyi dkar chag tu'ang gsal bas de bzhin shes par bya'o/
